table.retrieve:
SELECT	h.adjcode, 
	DocumentCode=Case h.adjcatcode WHEN 1 THEN 'AI-' ELSE 'AD-' END + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(h.adjcode,10))),
	Type=Case h.adjcatcode WHEN 1 THEN 'INCREASE' ELSE 'DECREASE' END, 
	h.date, 
	d.icode,
	aliasname=i.customicode,
	item=i.name,
	d.batch,
	d.expiry, 
	d.looseqty,
	d.price,
	d.avgprice,
	d.saleprice,
	d.purprice,
	h.Usercode,
	u.username,
	h.posted
FROM adjheader h, adjdetail d, users u, item i
WHERE 	
	h.adjcode >= :ar_scode and 
	h.adjcode <= :ar_lcode and
	h.adjcode = d.adjcode and 
	h.adjcatcode IN (:aa_adjtype)and
	h.usercode = u.usercode and
	d.icode = i.icode
ORDER BY h.adjcode, d.adjutn, i.name, i.customicode, d.batch, d.expiry

objects.name: compute_5
objects.expression: Round(sum( looseqty * price * if(type='INCREASE', 1, -1) for all), 0)

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: Round(sum( looseqty * price * if(type='INCREASE', 1, -1)  for group 1), 0)
